title: Lead SAP EWM Consultant
jobDescription:

RESPONSIBILITIES:
We are looking for an experienced Senior SAP EWM Consultant to lead and deliver end‑to‑end SAP EWM implementations, including both Greenfield and Brownfield projects, with a strong focus on S/4HANA (Embedded or Decentralized). Key Responsibilities Lead full-cycle SAP EWM implementations and guide project teams across all phases. Conduct requirement gathering workshops, map business processes, and develop detailed solution blueprints for warehouse operations. Configure and customize EWM functionalities: Inbound/Outbound processes, Internal Movements, Physical Inventory, Kitting, VAS, and Quality Management. Design and manage integrations between SAP EWM and modules such as MM, SD, PP, QM, and TM, as well as third-party/external systems. Qualifications 7+ years of hands-on experience in SAP EWM. At least 2–3 end‑to‑end SAP EWM implementation projects (S/4HANA experience strongly preferred). Required Skills Strong command over core EWM processes, including warehouse structure setup (Storage Control, Bin Determination), Handling Units, and Packaging Specifications. In-depth understanding of integration touchpoints with MM, SD, QM, PP, and TM. ABAP debugging capabilities (reading and analyzing code); experience with BAd Is and User Exits is a strong plus. Knowledge of automation technologies such as Material Flow Systems (MFS) and RFID. Preferred Skills Prior experience working with BAd Is and User Exits. Compensation: As per Industry standards
